pr_title: Fix parsing cpu.max file in cgroup v2 implementation

issue_context.title: Setting --experimental_sandbox_limits=cpu=N fails with NoSuchElementException
issue_context.body:
### Description of the bug:


When running build with the flag `experimental_sandbox_limits` bazel fails with `NoSuchElementException`.
Looks like bazel is trying to read `cpu.max` from the cgroup and uses a skip regex `.*\\s` which causes the scanner to skip all input as `.*` matching is greedy and the value ends with a newline.

Example hexdump of some `cpu.max`:
```
0000000 155 141 170 040 061 060 060 060 060 060 012                    
0000000   m   a   x       1   0   0   0   0   0  \n                    
000000b
```

Command:
```
bazel build --incompatible_use_new_cgroup_implementation --experimental_sandbox_limits=cpu=1 //some:target
```

### Which category does this issue belong to?

Core, Local Execution

### What's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.


Run:
```
bazel build --incompatible_use_new_cgroup_implementation --experimental_sandbox_limits=cpu=1 //some:target
```

### Which operating system are you running Bazel on?


Linux
